描述_EN: many commentators on the subject saw these as part of an ongoing sexualisation of children. these primark bras and hanger were on sale in primark in 2012, as part of a range of underwear for children that included bras, since 2010. the items themselves were controversial when they were originally put on sale, especially those in the range that were padded.
描述_ZN: 许多评论家认为这些是正在进行的儿童性化的一部分。 这些primark胸罩和衣架于2012年在primark销售，作为包括胸罩在内的儿童内衣系列的一部分，从2010年开始。 这些商品本身在最初发售时就引起了争议，尤其是那些有填充物的系列。
